finding_statement: No approved and controlled information security policy in fictional ISMS
root_cause_hypothesis: Leadership sign-off workflow and document ownership have not been established

finding_statement: Approved recurring audit program and impartial audit arrangements absent
root_cause_hypothesis: Audit mandate and resourcing were omitted during initial ISMS setup

finding_statement: Baseline privileged MFA enforcement is incomplete across seven human identities
root_cause_hypothesis: No unified privileged identity inventory or exception governance in initial configuration

finding_statement: Six modeled overdue critical vulnerabilities have no documented exceptions
root_cause_hypothesis: Engineering remediation service-levels lack accountable enforcement and escalation

finding_statement: No completed critical workload restoration demonstration
root_cause_hypothesis: Continuity objectives not connected to witnessed service-level restore schedule

finding_statement: No evidence of operating ISMS management review process
root_cause_hypothesis: Leadership governance calendar and documented review outputs absent

finding_statement: Draft SoA exclusions and broad implementation evidence remain unapproved and incomplete
root_cause_hypothesis: Approval gate is missing from control applicability workflow

finding_statement: Only 16 of 30 staff attended security-awareness session in the original scenario
root_cause_hypothesis: HR training process has no completion escalation or learning-effectiveness check

finding_statement: Four of nine priority event sources are not represented in central monitoring
root_cause_hypothesis: Ingestion ownership and measurable source-onboarding schedule are incomplete
